combo1.title: Carol + Cielo: No More Bets! from two cards
combo1.description: Going first with Carol, the Elegance of Raise Moon and Cielo, the Veil of Raise Moon. Carol Normal Summons herself without Tributing and draws 1 card. Whatever that card is, it pays Cielo's cost: Cielo puts it on the bottom of the Deck and Special Summons herself. The two Level 7 "Raise Moon" monsters become Cielo, the Night Sky of Raise Moon - No More Bets! in the Extra Monster Zone. End board: No More Bets! with 2 materials. In the Extra Monster Zone it is unaffected by other cards' effects, it can turn an opponent's search into a draw, and it can detach a material on either player's turn to draw 1 card. The line doesn't depend on what Carol draws: it assumes a card that does nothing.

combo2.title: Carol + Stars of Raise Moon: Lapi off the top, No More Bets! and a draw
combo2.description: Going first with Carol, the Elegance of Raise Moon and Stars of Raise Moon. Stars puts Lapi, the Wings of Raise Moon on top of the Deck, so Carol's draw is Lapi, not a gamble. Lapi summons itself when drawn and draws 1 more card. Carol and Lapi become Cielo, the Night Sky of Raise Moon - No More Bets! in the Extra Monster Zone, and because a Spellcaster "Raise Moon" Xyz Monster is now on the field, Stars banishes itself from the GY to draw 1 card for you alone. End board: No More Bets! with 2 materials, and 2 extra cards in hand. Only Lapi's draw is known: the line treats the other two draws as cards that do nothing.

combo3.title: Going second: Carol + Stars of Raise Moon, Sharna and JACKPOT! clear three cards
combo3.description: Going second into a board, with Carol, the Elegance of Raise Moon and Stars of Raise Moon. Stars puts Sharna, the Blade of Raise Moon on top of the Deck, and Carol's draw takes it. Sharna was Summoned by its own draw effect, so it puts 1 of your opponent's monsters on the bottom of their Deck (this one targets). Carol and Sharna then become Squeeze, the Full Moon of Raise Moon - JACKPOT!, whose Xyz Summon detaches both materials to put 2 more of your opponent's cards on the bottom of their Deck without targeting. That's 3 cards gone from two cards in hand, and none of it destroys, so it gets past destruction protection. Only Sharna's draw is known: nothing else in the line depends on a draw.

combo4.title: Their turn: Lapi Xyz Summons JACKPOT! in the middle of their combo
combo4.description: Going first with Carol, the Elegance of Raise Moon and Stars of Raise Moon, but this time you keep Carol and Lapi, the Wings of Raise Moon on the field instead of making No More Bets!. Stars puts Lapi on top of the Deck, Carol's draw takes it, and Lapi summons itself and draws 1 more card. On your opponent's turn, once they have put two cards on the field, Lapi's Quick Effect Xyz Summons Squeeze, the Full Moon of Raise Moon - JACKPOT! from Carol and Lapi. It was Xyz Summoned, so it detaches both materials to put those 2 cards on the bottom of their Deck, without targeting. Lapi's Quick Effect works once per opponent's turn. Only Lapi's draw is known: the other draw is treated as a card that does nothing.

combo5.title: The Bright Lights of Raise Moon: No More Bets! on their turn from one Set card
combo5.description: Set The Bright Lights of Raise Moon on your turn. On your opponent's turn it Special Summons Cielo, the Night Sky of Raise Moon - No More Bets! from your Extra Deck to the Extra Monster Zone, with no materials needed, and attaches itself to it. That is the moment No More Bets! starts turning their searches into draws. It can detach Bright Lights right away to draw 1 card, and Bright Lights then banishes itself from your GY to draw 1 more. No More Bets! was not Xyz Summoned, so it can't be revived from the GY later. Activating either Bright Lights effect means you can't add cards from the Deck to your hand for the rest of the Duel, except by drawing them. Both draws are unknown: the line treats them as cards that do nothing.

combo6.title: Going second: City + Carol + Kulshe, a Trap and two monsters gone
combo6.description: Going second with Raise Moon - The City that Never Sleeps, Carol, the Elegance of Raise Moon and Kulshe, the Beacon of Raise Moon. Kulshe only summons itself when you draw it, so in the opening hand it is stuck. The City fixes that: its first effect puts a card from your hand on top of the Deck and then draws 1 card, so Kulshe goes on top and comes straight back. Kulshe was Summoned by its own draw effect, so it puts your opponent's Set Trap on the bottom of their Deck. Carol, Normal Summoned without Tributing, is the second Level 7, and the pair become Squeeze, the Full Moon of Raise Moon - JACKPOT!, which detaches both materials to put 2 monsters on the bottom of their Deck. The City stays, so the next time a Level 7 "Raise Moon" monster would be destroyed by a card effect this turn, it isn't, and in the End Phase the City shuffles your Raise Moon cards from the GY back into the Deck. Carol's draw is unknown: the line treats it as a card that does nothing.
